entries.en: The botanist arranged the photographs of Anthoceropsida beside the preserved specimens.
entries.zh: 植物学家把角苔纲植物的照片摆在保存的标本旁。

entries.en: A patch of Anthoceros appeared in the foreground of her drawing of the damp bank.
entries.zh: 她画的潮湿土坡前景中出现了一片角苔属植物。

entries.en: The guide returned to the display of Anthocerotaceae when a visitor asked another question.
entries.zh: 一位访客又提出问题，讲解员便回到了角苔科的展区。

entries.en: Their discussion of Anthocerotales continued while the students packed away their microscopes.
entries.zh: 学生们收起显微镜时，他们仍在讨论角苔目。

entries.en: The researcher compared the anthocyanase results from two separately labelled samples.
entries.zh: 研究人员比较了两份分别标记的样品的花色素酶检测结果。

entries.en: The old account of anthocyaninuria included observations that were absent from the later summary.
entries.zh: 那份关于花青苷尿的旧记述中，有些观察记录没有出现在后来的摘要里。

entries.en: The paleontologist borrowed an old monograph on Anthocyathea to check the damaged fossil illustration.
entries.zh: 古生物学家借来一本关于花古杯纲的旧专著，核对那幅受损的化石插图。

entries.en: Her illustrations of Anthomedusae filled an entire panel of the marine exhibition.
entries.zh: 她画的花水母亚目插图占满了海洋展的一整块展板。

entries.en: A student left her drawings of Anthomyia beside the entomologist's magnifier.
entries.zh: 一名学生把自己画的花蝇属昆虫图放在昆虫学家的放大镜旁。

entries.en: The museum needed a larger drawer for its collection of Anthomyiidae.
entries.zh: 博物馆需要一个更大的抽屉来存放花蝇科的藏品。

entries.en: The illustrator enlarged the Anthonomus specimen so that its outline remained clear in print.
entries.zh: 插画师把花象属标本画得更大，好让它的轮廓印出来后仍然清楚。

entries.en: Her anthophobia made the unexpected bouquet upsetting rather than pleasant.
entries.zh: 由于对花感到恐惧，意外收到的那束花让她难受，而不是高兴。

entries.en: The artist placed an anthophorous branch beside a bare one in the botanical study.
entries.zh: 画家在那幅植物习作中，把一枝开花的枝条画在一枝光秃的枝条旁。

entries.en: The exhibition devoted its final room to Anthophyta rather than the fossil groups displayed earlier.
entries.zh: 展览把最后一个房间留给了有花植物，而不是前面展示的那些化石类群。

entries.en: The old drawings of Anthosomidae were too fragile to display without protective glass.
entries.zh: 那些花瓣鱼虱科旧图太脆弱，必须隔着保护玻璃才能展出。

entries.en: The difference in anthotaxy became obvious when we placed the two botanical sketches side by side.
entries.zh: 我们把两幅植物素描并排放好后，花序的差异便一目了然了。

entries.en: The photographer asked to see the museum's Anthozoa collection before choosing subjects for the catalogue.
entries.zh: 摄影师请求先看看博物馆的珊瑚虫类藏品，再为图录挑选拍摄对象。

entries.en: The chemist marked the anthra-glucoside peak on a separate copy of the chromatogram.
entries.zh: 化学家在另一份色谱图副本上标出了蒽苷的峰。

entries.en: The historical case notes described anthracaemia, but the accompanying blood-test records had been lost.
entries.zh: 那些历史病例笔记记载了炭疽菌血症，但随附的血液检验记录已经丢失。

entries.en: The chapter on anthracemia was missing from the damaged medical volume.
entries.zh: 那本受损的医学书缺了关于炭疽菌血症的一章。

entries.en: The chemist compared the anthracene spectrum with the reference spectrum, not with the handwritten sketch.
entries.zh: 化学家把蒽的光谱与参照光谱进行了比较，而不是与那幅手绘草图比较。

entries.en: An unclear label prevented the student from identifying the anthracenol sample in the collection.
entries.zh: 标签不清，学生因而无法辨认藏品中那份蒽酚样品。

entries.en: The historian compared two early descriptions of anthracic infection without treating them as modern clinical guidance.
entries.zh: 史学研究者比较了两份早期的炭疽感染描述，没有把它们当作现代临床指南。

entries.en: The review questioned the preparation's claimed anthracidal activity because the supporting records were incomplete.
entries.zh: 由于支持材料不完整，那篇综述质疑了该制剂所声称的杀炭疽菌活性。

entries.en: The old diagram of anthracin accompanied a discussion of bacterial toxins rather than coal-tar chemistry.
entries.zh: 那幅炭疽菌素旧图配在细菌毒素的讨论旁，而不是煤焦油化学的讨论旁。

entries.en: The grower photographed the fruit affected by anthracnose before preparing her report.
entries.zh: 种植者先拍摄了受炭疽病影响的果实，再撰写报告。

entries.en: The old vineyard report discussed anthracnosis alongside drawings of the damaged leaves.
entries.zh: 那份旧葡萄园报告在讨论炭疽病的同时，附上了受损叶片的图画。

entries.en: The illustration showed an anthracoid lesion, but the case notes did not establish its cause.
entries.zh: 插图显示了一处似炭痈的病变，但病例笔记没有确定其病因。

entries.en: The lecturer used the old gas-analysis apparatus to introduce the history of anthracometry.
entries.zh: 讲者借那台旧气体分析仪介绍了二氧化碳测量法的历史。

entries.en: The drawing of anthraconecrosis was clearer than the faded photograph attached to the case notes.
entries.zh: 那幅黑色干性坏死绘图，比病例笔记所附的褪色照片更清楚。

entries.en: The old case description of anthracophlyctis ended before the author discussed the patient's recovery.
entries.zh: 那份炭疽脓疱旧病例说明还没谈到患者的康复情况就结束了。

entries.en: Her research on anthracosilicosis included interviews with retired miners about their working lives.
entries.zh: 她对煤矽肺的研究包括采访退休矿工，了解他们的工作经历。

entries.en: The lecturer enlarged the photograph of the anthracotic lung before discussing the old case report.
entries.zh: 讲者先放大了那张炭肺照片，再讨论那份旧病例报告。

entries.en: A damaged sack of Anthrafilt stood beside the waterworks' replacement filter parts.
entries.zh: 一袋包装破损的过滤用无烟煤放在水厂的备用过滤器零件旁。

entries.en: The textile historian compared an anthraflavine sample with the colour recorded in the dyer's notebook.
entries.zh: 纺织史研究者把一份蒽黄素样品与染工笔记中记载的颜色进行了比较。

entries.en: The analyst requested another copy of the anthragallol spectrum because the original print was smudged.
entries.zh: 原来的打印件有污迹，分析人员于是要求再提供一份三羟基蒽醌光谱图。

entries.en: The museum borrowed a photograph of an anthralin container for its exhibition on pharmaceutical packaging.
entries.zh: 博物馆为药品包装展借来了一张地蒽酚容器的照片。

entries.en: The article on anthramycin contained two figures that were missing from the conference handout.
entries.zh: 那篇安曲霉素文章中有两幅图，没有出现在会议讲义里。

entries.en: The paper compared one anthranilate ester with two closely related esters.
entries.zh: 那篇论文比较了一种邻氨基苯甲酸酯与两种密切相关的酯。

entries.en: The molecular drawing of anthranoyllycoctonine was too crowded to read at the original printing size.
entries.zh: 安茴酰牛扁碱的分子结构图太密，以原来的印刷尺寸看不清楚。

entries.en: The student corrected the anthraquinone drawing after comparing it with the reference structure.
entries.zh: 学生对照参照结构后，改正了蒽醌的绘图。

entries.en: The historian found a damaged colour chart beside the old anthrarobin samples.
entries.zh: 史学研究者在那些旧脱氧茜素样品旁发现了一张受损的色卡。

entries.en: The chemist noticed a second label beneath the faded anthrarufin label on the container.
entries.zh: 化学家注意到，容器上那张褪色的蒽绛酚标签下面还有另一张标签。

entries.en: The report compared two proposed structures of anthratetrol but favoured neither interpretation.
entries.zh: 那份报告比较了两种提出的蒽四酚结构，但没有倾向任何一种解释。

entries.en: The illustration of anthrathiophene needed a wider margin for the editor's annotations.
entries.zh: 蒽并噻吩的插图需要留出更宽的页边，供编辑作批注。

entries.en: A missing page interrupted the discussion of anthratriol in the chemist's manuscript.
entries.zh: 化学家的手稿缺了一页，打断了其中对蒽三酚的讨论。

entries.en: The entomologist borrowed a larger magnifier to examine the museum's Anthribidae specimens.
entries.zh: 昆虫学家借来一把更大的放大镜，观察博物馆的长角象虫科标本。

entries.en: The final proof omitted the anthrimide figure that the author had carefully redrawn.
entries.zh: 最终校样漏掉了作者精心重画的二蒽醌亚胺插图。

entries.en: A folded drawing of Anthriscus fell from the botanical album when she opened it.
entries.zh: 她打开植物画册时，一张折叠的峨参属植物绘图掉了出来。

entries.en: The analyst compared the anthrol chromatogram with the earlier chromatogram in the notebook.
entries.zh: 分析人员把蒽酚色谱图与笔记本中较早的那份色谱图进行了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 类人猿亚目〔旧分类名称〕
entries.en: The historian compared two early classifications of Anthropoidea before writing the exhibition notes.
entries.zh: 史学研究者比较了两种早期的类人猿亚目分类，才撰写展览说明。

entries.en: The folded anthropometer would not fit into the narrow drawer beside the other measuring instruments.
entries.zh: 折叠起来的人体测量器仍放不进其他测量仪器旁的那个窄抽屉。

entries.en: The library moved the old volumes on anthroposomatology into a larger reading room.
entries.zh: 图书馆把那些人体学旧书搬进了一间更大的阅览室。

entries.en: Her exhibition on the history of anthropotomy included drawings borrowed from three medical libraries.
entries.zh: 她举办的人体解剖学历史展中，有从三家医学图书馆借来的绘图。

entries.meaningZh: 人兽病；人与动物共患的疾病
entries.en: The doctors and veterinarians prepared a joint review of the anthropozoonosis cases.
entries.zh: 医生与兽医共同整理了那些人兽共患疾病的病例综述。

entries.en: The students compared the recorded feeding patterns of anthropozoophilic mosquitoes.
entries.zh: 学生们比较了记录中嗜人兽血蚊子的取食模式。

entries.en: The bold line marks the anthryl group in the molecular drawing.
entries.zh: 分子结构图中的粗线标出了蒽基。

entries.en: The restored illustrations of Anthuridea returned to the marine museum after the exhibition.
entries.zh: 展览结束后，修复好的花尾亚目插图回到了海洋博物馆。

entries.en: The pressed anthyllis flowers had faded before the artist completed her botanical study.
entries.zh: 画家还没完成那幅植物习作，压制保存的治伤绒毛花就已经褪色了。

entries.en: Critics questioned the bitter drink's claimed anthypnotic effect rather than its flavour.
entries.zh: 批评者质疑的是那种苦味饮料所声称的提神作用，而不是它的味道。

entries.en: The historian examined an advertisement claiming anthysteric properties for a nineteenth-century preparation.
entries.zh: 史学研究者查看了一则广告，广告声称一种十九世纪制剂具有抗癔病作用。

entries.en: The chemist redrew the anti-aldoximes after finding that the first diagrams were reversed.
entries.zh: 化学家发现最初的示意图画反了，于是重画了那些反式醛肟。

entries.en: The review compared the evidence for the two products' claimed anti-allergic effects.
entries.zh: 那篇综述比较了支持两款产品所声称的抗过敏作用的证据。

entries.en: The debate about trade policy gradually became a debate about anti-Americanism.
entries.zh: 那场关于贸易政策的辩论，逐渐变成了一场关于反美情绪的辩论。

entries.en: The conference programme listed anti-anemia treatment separately from the session on diagnostic tests.
entries.zh: 会议日程把抗贫血治疗与诊断检测的专题分别列出。

entries.en: The lecture compared early accounts of anti-auxins with more recent plant-growth studies.
entries.zh: 那场讲座把早期关于抗生长素的记述与较新的植物生长研究进行了比较。

entries.en: The article discussed an anti-estrogen, not a replacement estrogen.
entries.zh: 那篇文章讨论的是一种抗雌激素，而不是替代用的雌激素。

entries.en: The old advertisement promised anti-fat benefits without presenting a supporting study.
entries.zh: 那则旧广告许诺有防胖效果，却没有提供支持这一说法的研究。

entries.en: The chemist questioned the reported anti-fermentative effect because the comparison data were missing.
entries.zh: 由于比较数据缺失，化学家对报告中的防发酵作用提出了疑问。

entries.en: The copied report contained anti-HAV results but omitted the sample collection date.
entries.zh: 那份报告副本有甲型肝炎病毒抗体检测结果，却没有标明采样日期。

entries.meaningZh: 抗乙型肝炎核心抗原的抗体
entries.en: The researcher checked the anti-HBc column separately from the surface-antigen column.
entries.zh: 研究人员把抗乙型肝炎核心抗原抗体一栏与表面抗原一栏分开核对。

entries.meaningZh: 抗乙肝表面抗原的抗体
entries.en: A missing column obscured the anti-HBsAg results in the copied report.
entries.zh: 报告副本缺了一栏，使抗乙肝表面抗原抗体的结果看不清楚。

entries.en: The laboratory returned the anti-HCV report with the patient's details corrected.
entries.zh: 实验室退回了那份抗丙型肝炎病毒抗体报告，患者资料已经更正。

entries.en: The old article distinguished an anti-hormone from a replacement hormone.
entries.zh: 那篇旧文章区分了抗激素与替代用的激素。

entries.en: The laboratory ordered an anti-human antibody for the teaching demonstration.
entries.zh: 实验室为教学演示订购了一种抗人抗体。

entries.en: The new catalogue groups anti-infectious medicines by their active ingredients.
entries.zh: 新目录按照活性成分对抗感染药物进行分类。

entries.en: The pharmacist found the leaflet for the anti-inflammatory cream inside the wrong carton.
entries.zh: 药剂师在错误的纸盒中找到了那支抗炎乳膏的说明书。

entries.en: The researcher questioned whether the proposed anti-irritant had actually been present in both samples.
entries.zh: 研究人员质疑，所提出的抗刺激剂是否确实存在于两份样品中。

entries.meaningZh: 前黎巴嫩山；外黎巴嫩山
entries.en: Her faded photograph of the Anti-Lebanon was too wide for the album's narrow pages.
entries.zh: 她那张褪色的前黎巴嫩山照片太宽，放不进相册的窄页面。

entries.en: The medical-history exhibition displayed an anti-lewisite container beside its original packaging.
entries.zh: 医学史展把一个二巯基丙醇容器与原包装一同展出。

entries.en: The committee reviewed expenditure on each anti-malarial separately from the other medicines.
entries.zh: 委员会把每种抗疟疾药的开支与其他药物的费用分开审查。

entries.en: The historian compared two anti-opium pamphlets published in different towns.
entries.zh: 史学研究者比较了两份在不同城镇出版的禁鸦片烟小册子。

entries.en: The chemist corrected the drawing of the anti-oxime before submitting the paper.
entries.zh: 化学家改正了反式肟的绘图，才提交论文。

entries.en: The diagram used a different symbol for each anti-particle.
entries.zh: 那幅示意图用不同的符号表示每一种反粒子。

entries.en: The materials budget listed anti-rads separately from the other polymer additives.
entries.zh: 材料预算把抗射线老化剂与其他聚合物添加剂分开列出。

entries.en: The conference had separate sessions on anti-retroviral treatment and vaccine research.
entries.zh: 会议分别设有抗逆转录病毒治疗和疫苗研究的专题。

entries.en: A replacement anti-scorcher appeared in the materials budget for the rubber factory.
entries.zh: 橡胶厂的材料预算中列出了一种替代用的防焦剂。

entries.en: The materials list included an anti-softener but omitted its supplier.
entries.zh: 材料清单中列有一种防软剂，却没有注明供应商。

entries.en: She packed the spare circuit board in an anti-static bag before the journey.
entries.zh: 出发前，她把备用电路板装进了抗静电袋。

entries.en: The historian found an advertisement for an anti-syphilitic between the pages of the old journal.
entries.zh: 史学研究者在那本旧期刊的书页之间发现了一则治梅毒药广告。

entries.en: The editor moved the review of anti-viral medicines to the next issue.
entries.zh: 编辑把那篇抗病毒药物综述移到了下一期。

entries.meaningZh: 抗动物毒素〔旧医学名称〕
entries.en: The early report on anti-zootoxin referred to a separate account of the corresponding toxin.
entries.zh: 那份早期的抗动物毒素报告提到了另一份关于相应毒素的记述。

entries.en: The veterinary paper compared antiabortus serum with a control serum.
entries.zh: 那篇兽医学论文比较了抗流产杆菌血清与对照血清。

entries.en: The old diagram placed antiabrin beside the corresponding abrin preparation.
entries.zh: 那幅旧图把抗相思豆毒素画在相应的相思豆毒素制剂旁。

entries.meaningZh: 扁桃体肿大〔旧医学名称〕
entries.en: The illustration of antiadoncus had been cut out of the old clinical volume.
entries.zh: 那本旧临床书中的扁桃体肿大插图被剪走了。

entries.en: The rubber supplier changed the antiager without updating the product sheet.
entries.zh: 橡胶供应商更换了防老剂，却没有更新产品资料表。

entries.en: The paper distinguishes antiagglutinating activity from anticoagulant activity.
entries.zh: 那篇论文区分了抗凝集作用与抗凝血作用。

entries.en: The hand-drawn diagram placed the antiagglutinin beside its target agglutinin.
entries.zh: 那幅手绘示意图把抗凝集素画在其靶物凝集素旁。

entries.meaningZh: 抗攻击素〔旧免疫学名称〕
entries.en: The early article discussed antiaggressin within a theory that later authors questioned.
entries.zh: 那篇早期文章在一种后来受到其他作者质疑的理论框架下讨论了抗攻击素。

entries.en: The review questioned the serum's claimed antialexic effect because the original records were incomplete.
entries.zh: 原始记录不完整，那篇综述因而质疑了该血清所声称的抗补体作用。

entries.en: The diagram of antialexin was damaged near the part representing its target.
entries.zh: 抗补体示意图中，表示其靶物的部分附近有破损。

entries.en: The report separates antiallergenic action from the absence of allergens.
entries.zh: 那份报告区分了抗变应作用与不含变应原这两回事。

entries.en: The package advertised antiallergic properties but did not list the ingredients.
entries.zh: 包装宣称具有抗过敏作用，却没有列出成分。

entries.meaningZh: 抗介体；抗抗体〔旧免疫学名称〕
entries.en: The drawing of the antiamboceptor was smudged near the binding site.
entries.zh: 抗介体绘图上，结合位点附近有污迹。

entries.en: The pharmacist compared the packaging of the antianaemic with the image in the catalogue.
entries.zh: 药剂师把那种抗贫血药的包装与图录中的图片进行了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 抗过敏素〔旧免疫学名称〕
entries.en: The old diagram connected antianaphylactin with its target, but the accompanying notes were missing.
entries.zh: 那幅旧图把抗过敏素与其靶物联系在一起，但随附的笔记缺失了。

entries.en: Her thesis compared two early explanations of antianaphylaxis rather than current treatment protocols.
entries.zh: 她的论文比较了两种早期对抗过敏性的解释，而不是现行治疗方案。

entries.en: The hospital's report discussed spending on antianemic medicines without comparing their clinical effects.
entries.zh: 医院的报告讨论了抗贫血药物的开支，没有比较它们的临床效果。

entries.en: The pharmacy's stock of antianginals had fallen below the figure in the inventory.
entries.zh: 药房的抗心绞痛药库存已经低于清单所列的数量。

entries.en: An antianopheline campaign appeared in the town's old public-health records.
entries.zh: 那座城镇的旧公共卫生记录中记载了一场抗按蚊运动。

entries.en: The schematic shows an antiantibody binding to another antibody.
entries.zh: 那幅示意图显示了抗抗体与另一种抗体结合的情形。

entries.en: The model represents the antiantitoxin attached to an antitoxin.
entries.zh: 那个模型显示了抗抗毒素与一种抗毒素相连的情形。

entries.meaningZh: 制性欲的；制欲的〔旧用语〕
entries.en: The historian questioned the advertisement's unsupported claims of antiaphrodisiac effects.
entries.zh: 史学研究者质疑了那则广告中缺乏支持依据的制性欲作用说法。

entries.meaningZh: 防止中风的〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The old pamphlet praised the pills' supposed antiapoplectic properties without providing evidence.
entries.zh: 那本旧小册子赞扬了药丸据称具有的防中风作用，却没有提供证据。

entries.meaningZh: 南洋箭毒树；见血封喉树
entries.en: The artist redrew the antiar tree after the original sketch was damaged by rain.
entries.zh: 原来的素描被雨水损坏后，画家重画了那棵见血封喉树。

entries.en: The botanical exhibition displayed photographs of Antiaris beside the artist's unfinished sketches.
entries.zh: 植物展把见血封喉属植物的照片与画家未完成的素描一同展出。

entries.en: The student revised her explanation of antiaromaticity after checking the reference structure.
entries.zh: 学生核对参照结构后，修改了自己对反芳香性的解释。

entries.en: The review compares published trials of antiarrhythmic drugs without recommending a particular product.
entries.zh: 那篇综述比较了已发表的抗心律失常药物试验，没有推荐某种具体产品。

entries.en: A missing annotation left the role of antiautolysin unclear in the old experiment.
entries.zh: 由于缺了一条批注，抗自溶素在那项旧实验中的作用并不清楚。

entries.en: The discussion distinguishes antibacteriolytic activity from antibacterial activity.
entries.zh: 那场讨论区分了抗溶菌作用与抗菌作用。

entries.en: His historical review challenged the syrup's claimed antibechic properties.
entries.zh: 他的历史综述质疑了那种糖浆所声称的镇咳作用。

entries.en: The museum displayed an advertisement for antibilious pills beside a nineteenth-century medicine chest.
entries.zh: 博物馆在一个十九世纪药箱旁展出了一则抗胆病药丸广告。

entries.en: The historian compared two advertisements claiming antiblennorrhagic effects.
entries.zh: 史学研究者比较了两则声称具有抗淋病作用的广告。

entries.en: The diagram shows antibody-coated beads beside the plain control beads.
entries.zh: 那幅示意图显示了抗体覆盖的微珠，旁边是普通的对照微珠。

entries.meaningZh: 艾滋病病毒抗体检测呈阳性的
entries.en: The report classified the HIV test samples as antibody-positive or antibody-negative.
entries.zh: 报告将艾滋病病毒检测样本分为抗体阳性或抗体阴性。

entries.en: The illustrator left the antibrachial region unfinished when the studio lights failed.
entries.zh: 工作室的灯坏了，插画师还没画完前臂区域。

entries.en: The artist shortened the model's antibrachium after noticing that the proportions were wrong.
entries.zh: 画家发现比例不对后，把模型的前臂改短了。

entries.en: The perfumer rejected the proposed antibromic because its scent overwhelmed the soap's fragrance.
entries.zh: 调香师拒绝采用所提出的除臭剂，因为它的气味盖过了肥皂的香气。

entries.en: The council's archives contain posters from an antibubonic campaign.
entries.zh: 市政委员会的档案中保存着一场抗腺鼠疫运动的海报。

entries.meaningZh: 抗恶病质的〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The historical review questioned the preparation's claimed anticachectic properties.
entries.zh: 那篇历史综述质疑了该制剂所声称的抗恶病质作用。

entries.en: The dental study questioned the mouthwash's claimed anticalculous effect.
entries.zh: 那项牙科研究质疑了该漱口水所声称的防牙垢作用。

entries.meaningZh: 抗癌抗体〔旧假说中的物质〕
entries.en: The historian traced the debate over anticancrin through a series of early cancer studies.
entries.zh: 史学研究者通过一系列早期癌症研究，梳理了围绕旧说中抗癌抗体的争论。

entries.en: The advertisement promised anticanitic effects but provided no supporting study.
entries.zh: 广告许诺具有抗白发作用，却没有提供支持这一说法的研究。

entries.en: The final spectrum of anticapsin was clearer than the preliminary scan.
entries.zh: 抗荚膜菌素的最终光谱图比初步扫描得到的图更清楚。
